reply: Thank you for explaining that your payment app account was closed for an alleged terms of service issue and that you lost access to funds as a result. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for the specific reason for the closure and how any remaining balance will be returned, and keep the closure notice. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $14,000.00 wire went to the wrong account by mistake, that the receiving bank needs a hold harmless letter, and that no department can tell you who issues it. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the wire transfers team. Please keep your claim number and the receiving bank's request, and ask for one contact to handle the letter. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your long-standing payment app account was closed for a terms of service reason without further explanation. We understand how disruptive this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the closure notice and a record of your calls, and ask in writing for the reason for the closure and how any remaining balance will be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an item bought through an online ad arrived late and not as described, and that a refund requires costly international return shipping that was not disclosed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the ad, the order confirmation, photos of the item and your appeal messages. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you could not use your $180.00 balance on the website and were required to install the app and complete biometric checks your phone does not support. We understand your concern about access to your funds. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for another way to verify your identity and access your balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your transfers and card additions keep being declined by automated risk controls, without a clear reason or a way to escalate. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the decline messages with their dates, and ask in writing what steps could restore normal access. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your investments were sold and withdrawn without your permission, that you could not reach a person while it was happening, and that your claims were denied. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep your police report and support case numbers, and close or secure any affected accounts and devices. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,700.00 check you paid extra to load instantly has not been made available after nearly three weeks, despite several escalations. We are sorry this has put you behind on rent and bills. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the load confirmation, fee receipt and the dates you were given, and ask for a written timeline. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that funds were moved from your investment account into your IRA without your authorization, leaving the first account negative with fees. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep statements from both accounts showing the transfer and the fees, and a note of the manager's call. Report the transfer in writing to both institutions. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,000.00 international transfer was delivered to the wrong bank according to the receipt, and that you have not been able to reach the provider. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please notify the provider of the error in writing with the transaction number and the correct bank details, and keep your receipt. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a balance transfer check was withdrawn from your credit line but never reached the intended account, which you later learned does not accept balance transfers. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep the check number and withdrawal date, and ask in writing where the check was cashed and how it can be recovered. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your dispute about a $95.00 transfer was denied because the funds could not be recovered. We understand your disappointment. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the dispute decision and tell us whether you authorized the transfer or were tricked into sending it, as this affects how it is reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that security holds prevent you from transferring your cryptocurrency, and that you have not been given a reason or timeline. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep your case number and the dates of each contact, and ask in writing what is needed to release the holds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $2,000.00 for custom goods that were never shipped, that the seller would only ship if you withdrew your dispute, and that the dispute was closed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the invoice, the tracking details showing no scans and the seller's messages. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have paid repeated fees, including clearance fees, to someone handling a transfer, and that you are now being asked for more. We are concerned this may be a scam, because genuine transfers do not require repeated advance fees. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please stop sending money and contact your bank using the number on its official website. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $160.00 was transferred out of your account without your permission and that your disputes were denied despite a police report. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your police report and the dates you reported each transfer. Prompt reporting of unauthorized transfers helps protect your rights. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $410.00 your family sent is shown as delivered, but it has not appeared in your account after 14 days. We understand your frustration with being sent between companies. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep the transfer tracking number and your bank statements for those dates, and ask the bank in writing to search for the incoming payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged $59.00 instead of $9.00, and that your dispute was denied because the app would not let you upload your evidence. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep screenshots of the upload errors and the original ad, and ask in writing for another way to submit your documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that money was taken from your payment app account while you left your card in your room, and that your account was then blocked. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please note the date and amount if you can, and ask in writing how to regain access to your account. Prompt reporting of unauthorized transactions helps. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $50.00 payment went to a recipient whose account is no longer active, and that your dispute was denied. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team, including the status of the recipient account. Please keep the transaction details and the dispute decision, and a note of when you tried to cancel. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot cancel your paid credit monitoring membership because you cannot log in or reach a person. We understand your concern about continued billing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the consumer services team. Please send a written cancellation request by mail, keep a copy, and check your card statements for further charges you can dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was limited over four years ago and that your remaining balance has still not been released. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the limitation notice and your support messages, and ask in writing for the policy under which the funds are held and when they will be released. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot convert or withdraw your funds to your US bank account because of a location restriction and verification failures. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the email chain and screenshots, and ask in writing for the specific policy applied and the steps to complete a withdrawal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $28,000.00 wire left your bank but the receiving bank has no record of it. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the wire transfers team. Please keep the wire confirmation and the instructions used, and ask your bank in writing for a full trace, including any intermediary bank. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $1,500.00 for a vehicle that was never delivered, after receiving a signed bill of sale. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the bill of sale, the payment receipt, the listing and all messages. If you believe this was a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan repayment setting was described incorrectly, that a deduction was taken but not credited, and that a late fee posted before the deadline. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the screenshots of your repayment setting, the due date changes and the fee time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $320.00 from four delivered orders has not been paid out, even though newer payouts are arriving. We understand your frustration with the error message. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payouts team. Please keep the order numbers, delivery confirmations and screenshots of the payout message. These will help the review trace each payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you could not cancel a $2,500.00 transfer within the time window described in the company's materials. We understand your frustration while trying to pay your contractor. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep a screenshot of the cancellation policy and the transfer confirmation, and note the time you tried to cancel. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your international wire was rejected by an intermediary bank for an incorrect code, even though the recipient's bank confirmed the code in writing. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the wire transfers team. Please keep the written confirmation from the recipient's bank and the rejection details, and ask for the bank address held on file to be checked. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a customer said they sent you $750.00 through a transfer service, but you never received it. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please ask the sender for the transfer receipt and tracking number, and check that your details match what was sent, since mismatched information can stop delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
